description_en: Queries the information about O\&M events
description_zh: 调用DescribeMaintenanceAction接口查询运维事件的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-maintenance-action --biz-region cn-hangzhou --task-type rds_apsaradb_upgrade --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMaintenanceAction

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. Valid values:

The ID of the region where the O\&M event occurs. Example: `cn-hangzhou`. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list.
You can also set Region to `all` to query the O\&M events in all regions. If you set `Region` to `all`, you must set `TaskType` to `all`
parameters.help_zh:
地域。取值如下：
运维事件所在地域的地域ID，如`cn-hangzhou`。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID。
您也可以输入`all`查看当前账号下所有地域下的所有运维事件，当`Region`设置为`all`时，`TaskType`也必须设置为`all`
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O\&M event. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_upgrade: database software upgrades.
all: all the O\&M events in all regions within the current account. If you set `Region` to `all`, you must set `TaskType` to `all`
parameters.help_zh:
运维事件的类型，取值如下：
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：数据库软件升级。
all：查看当前账号下所有地域下的所有运维事件，当`Region`设置为`all`时，`TaskType`也必须设置为`all`
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the information about pending or historical O\&M events. Valid values:

0: returns the information about pending O\&M event.
1: returns the information about historical O\&M event.

If you do not specify this parameter, the information about pending O\&M event are returned
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回待处理或历史运维事件的详情，取值如下：
0：返回待处理运维事件的详情。
1：返回历史运维事件的详情。

若该参数留空，默认返回待处理运维事件的详情
parameters.name: is_history

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值为30（默认值）、50或100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the O\&M event occurs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
运维事件所在地域的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O\&M event was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 运维事件的创建时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

DBClusterId.description_en: The ID of the cluster that is involved in the O\&M event
DBClusterId.description_zh: 运维事件所涉及集群的集群ID

DBVersion.description_en: The version of the database engine

Deadline.description_en: The deadline before which the event can be executed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
Deadline.description_zh: 运维事件执行时间可调整范围的最晚时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

Id.description_en: The ID of the O\&M event

ModifiedTime.description_en: The point in time at which the switchover time of the O\&M event was modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改运维事件切换时间的时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

PrepareInterval.description_en: The preparation time that is required before the pending O\&M event can be switched. The time is in the `HH:mm:ss` format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 运维事件切换之前所需的准备时间，格式为`HH:mm:ss`

Region.description_en: The ID of the region where the O\&M event occurs
Region.description_zh: 运维事件所在地域的地域ID

ResultInfo.description_en:
The execution result of the O\&M event.

This parameter is returned only when the value of `Status` is FAILED or CANCEL
ResultInfo.description_zh:
运维事件的执行结果。
仅当`Status`（状态）取值为FAILED（运维事件结束但执行失败）或CANCEL（事件已取消）时，返回该参数

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task was executed in the backend. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行该运维事件的时间点，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The state of the event.

If you set `IsHistory` to 0, the state of the pending O\&M event is returned. Valid values:

    *   WAITING_MODIFY: The start time of the O\&M event is waiting to be set.
    *   WAITING: The O\&M event is waiting to be processed.
    *   PROCESSING: The O\&M event is being processed. The switchover time of an event in this state cannot be changed.

If you set `IsHistory` to 1, the state of the historical O\&M event is returned. Valid values:

    *   SUCCESS: The event ended and the execution succeeded.
    *   FAILED: The event ended but the execution failed.
    *   CANCEL: The event was canceled
Status.description_zh:
事件状态。
若您设置`IsHistory`为0，则返回待处理运维事件状态的详情，取值范围如下：
    - WAITING_MODIFY：等待用户设置运维事件开始时间。
    - WAITING：运维事件正在等待处理。
    - PROCESSING：运维事件正在处理中（不支持修改处于该状态下事件的切换时间）。
若您设置`IsHistory`为1，则返回历史运维事件状态的详情，取值范围如下：
     - SUCCESS：事件结束且执行成功。
     - FAILED：事件结束但执行失败。
     - CANCEL：事件已取消

SwitchTime.description_en: The time when the pending O\&M event is switched. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
SwitchTime.description_zh: 运维事件预计的切换时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

TaskType.description_en: The type of the O\&M event

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
